生成された動画：=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Riven must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.

Preserve her facial appearance, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her clothing or armor.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

This scene takes place many years after Riven's childhood.

Riven has spent many years practicing swordsmanship under her Father's guidance.

She is now highly capable with a sword.

She has strong balance, disciplined footwork, confident weapon control, and years of practiced technique.

However, she has not yet experienced real warfare.

Her skill comes from years of training rather than battlefield experience.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

Riven does not speak in this scene.


RIVEN'S FATHER:

Riven's Father must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.

Preserve his facial appearance, hair, beard, body proportions, clothing, and overall silhouette.

He is the same quiet former warrior who raised Riven and taught her swordsmanship.

Many years have passed since he first taught her basic stance and grip.

He no longer needs to physically correct her movements.

He mainly watches her train.

Their relationship should feel familiar, quiet, and natural.

He does not speak in this scene.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

The scene takes place beside Riven's family cottage in the same peaceful medieval-fantasy mountain village where she grew up.

Maintain the recognizable environment:

the small family cottage,
the old tree,
the chopping area,
stacked firewood,
the dirt-and-grass training area,
the village road,
nearby cottages,
the broad green valley,
and rugged mountains in the distance.

The village is peaceful and safe.

Soft natural daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Subtle chimney smoke.

Quiet rural activity.

The dirt road passing through the village is clearly visible from the training area.

Nothing is damaged.

Nothing is burning.

There is no danger.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight and metal physics.

Realistic footwork and body balance.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict character appearance, costume consistency, sword consistency, and body proportions throughout the entire video.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Patient pacing.

Restrained editing.

Avoid excessive cuts.

Avoid rapid montage.

Avoid exaggerated slow motion.

Avoid supernatural movement.

Avoid flashy magical effects.

Avoid acrobatics.

Avoid spinning attacks.

Avoid exaggerated sword choreography.

This is NOT a battle.

This is NOT a rapid training montage.

The entire scene takes place as one continuous moment.

Riven is already skilled.

Do not portray her as a beginner.

Do not make her fall.

Do not make her struggle to hold the sword.

Do not have her Father physically correct her stance or grip.

No dialogue.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No intelligible background conversations.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Audio:

gentle mountain wind,
distant birds,
quiet village ambience,
boots moving against dirt,
realistic sword movement through air,
Riven's controlled breathing,
subtle movement of clothing and equipment,
later, distant horse hooves and subtle military equipment sounds.

No dramatic background music.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open directly on Riven practicing swordsmanship in the dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

The audience receives no verbal explanation of how much time has passed.

The passage of many years is communicated visually through Riven herself.

The little girl who once struggled with a sword is now completely comfortable holding one.

Riven performs a short sequence of grounded, controlled sword movements.

Her stance is stable.

Her footwork is precise.

Her grip is confident.

Her attacks are efficient.

Her recovery after every movement is clean.

The sword still has believable physical weight, but Riven understands how to move naturally with its momentum.

She does not show off.

She does not perform unnecessary flourishes.

Her Father stands nearby quietly observing.

He does not correct her.

He does not need to.

Riven completes the sequence cleanly and remains balanced.

Then distant horse hooves become audible from the village road.

Riven hears them.

She stops training.

Her attention shifts toward the sound.

A small disciplined group of medieval-fantasy soldiers is traveling through the village.

They are not attacking.

They are not threatening anyone.

They are simply passing through.

Riven watches them with quiet fascination.

Her attention is drawn to their disciplined movement, practical armor, weapons, horses, and the confidence of people accustomed to traveling beyond this isolated valley.

For Riven, they represent something she has never truly experienced:

the wider world beyond her home.

Riven looks briefly at the sword in her own hand.

Then she looks back toward the soldiers.

Her Father notices this.

His attention shifts away from the traveling soldiers and toward his daughter.

He understands what has captured her attention.

Riven does not notice him watching.

Neither character speaks.

Riven does not approach the soldiers.

Riven does not follow them.

End quietly.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — YEARS LATER

Begin with an extreme close-up of Riven's sword moving through the air.

The blade passes cleanly through frame with controlled speed.

The sound of the blade cutting through the air is sharp but realistic.

Pull back naturally and reveal Riven training in the familiar dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

Riven is already in motion.

She performs a controlled diagonal cut.

Her feet remain firmly positioned.

She immediately recovers the sword.

She changes her footing naturally.

She performs another practical movement.

The choreography is simple, efficient, and believable.

Do not turn this into a flashy combat combination.

The important difference is control.

Years ago, the sword controlled Riven's movement.

Now Riven controls the sword.

Its physical weight is still visible through her shoulders, hips, footwork, and momentum.

Riven transitions smoothly into one final controlled strike.

She stops the blade deliberately.

Returns to a stable stance.

Remains completely balanced.

Her breathing is controlled.

Hold briefly.

Reveal her Father nearby.

He has been quietly watching.

He does not correct her.

He does not give instructions.

He simply observes.

There should be a clear visual contrast with Riven's childhood training:

she no longer needs his hands correcting her grip,
she no longer loses her balance,
she no longer struggles with the weapon.

She has grown into the skill she once wanted.

Then:

distant horse hooves.

Riven hears them.

Her eyes shift toward the sound.

Her training stops.

She lowers the sword slightly.

CUT.


Shot 2 — THE WORLD BEYOND HOME

Follow Riven's attention toward the village road.

A small group of medieval-fantasy soldiers is traveling through the peaceful village.

The group should feel grounded and believable.

Some soldiers walk.

Some may travel slowly on horseback.

Their armor is practical and weathered rather than ceremonial.

Their weapons are carried naturally.

Their equipment moves realistically as they travel.

Their formation is organized and disciplined.

These soldiers are simply traveling through the region.

They are NOT attacking the village.

They are NOT intimidating villagers.

They are NOT behaving aggressively.

Do not portray them as sinister.

Do not create ominous imagery.

Do not foreshadow their future role as villains.

At this point in Riven's life, soldiers represent purpose, discipline, and the larger world she has imagined since childhood.

Ordinary village life continues naturally around them.

Riven watches silently from beside her cottage.

Show the soldiers primarily through Riven's perspective.

Her attention moves across small details:

worn armor from travel,

real military weapons,

horses carrying equipment,

disciplined posture,

coordinated movement,

people clearly accustomed to traveling far beyond this valley.

Nothing spectacular happens.

The importance comes entirely from Riven's reaction.

CUT.


Shot 3 — BEYOND THE VILLAGE

Return to Riven.

She stands completely still in the training area.

Her sword is lowered naturally beside her.

Her training has been forgotten for the moment.

The soldiers continue farther along the village road in the background.

Riven follows them with her eyes.

Her expression remains restrained.

Do not make her smile broadly.

Do not make her visibly excited.

Do not create a heroic pose.

Instead, show quiet fascination and curiosity.

Riven watches one of the traveling soldiers carrying a sword naturally while moving with the group.

Her eyes remain on the weapon for a moment.

Then Riven slowly looks down.

She looks at the sword in her own hand.

Hold.

Nothing magical happens.

The sword does not glow.

There is no vision.

There is no flashback.

There is no supernatural effect.

It is simply Riven looking at the weapon she has spent years learning to use.

Then she raises her eyes again.

She looks beyond the village.

The soldiers are moving farther down the road toward the valley beyond her home.

For the first time, the wider world feels tangible rather than imaginary.

Gentle wind moves Riven's pale-blonde hair and clothing.

Hold on her thoughtful expression.

Then shift attention naturally toward her Father.

He initially looks toward the road.

Then he looks at Riven.

He sees where her attention is.

He sees the sword in her hand.

He sees her watching the soldiers disappear beyond the village.

His expression changes only slightly.

He understands.

Do not make him visibly sad.

Do not make him smile.

Do not make the moment sentimental.

He simply realizes that his daughter is beginning to look beyond the life she has always known.

Riven does not notice her Father's gaze.

Neither character speaks.

The soldiers continue farther away.

Riven remains where she is.

She does not follow them.

Hold the final quiet composition:

Riven in the familiar place where she grew up,

her sword in her hand,

her Father nearby,

and the road stretching beyond the village toward the wider world.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven remains beside her family cottage.

She holds her sword naturally at her side.

Her Father stands nearby.

The traveling soldiers are disappearing along the road beyond the village.

Riven silently watches them leave.

She has not joined them.

She has not followed them.

She has not announced any decision.

Her Father has noticed the way she watches them.

He understands that something has changed.

Riven is still physically standing at home,

but mentally, for the first time, she is looking beyond it.

Neither character speaks.

End in silence.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Grounded.

Reflective.

Quietly ambitious.

Restrained.

The scene should communicate the passage of many years without explaining it.

The visual contrast with Riven's childhood is enough:

as a child, she struggled to control a sword;

now, she handles one naturally.

The emotional progression is simple:

Riven trains confidently
→ she completes the sequence cleanly
→ horse hooves interrupt the quiet
→ soldiers pass through the village
→ Riven becomes fascinated
→ she studies their weapons and discipline
→ she looks at her own sword
→ she looks toward the road beyond home
→ her Father notices.

Do not add another story event.

Do not have Riven speak.

Do not have her Father speak.

Do not have Riven approach the soldiers.

Do not have the soldiers approach Riven.

Do not have the soldiers recruit her.

Do not have Riven leave home.

Do not turn the soldiers into villains.

Do not introduce conflict.

The scene ends only with the first clear suggestion that Riven wants to discover the world beyond her village.、16:9

=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Riven must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.

Preserve her facial appearance, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her clothing or armor.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

This scene takes place many years after Riven's childhood.

Riven has spent many years practicing swordsmanship under her Father's guidance.

She is now highly capable with a sword.

She has strong balance, disciplined footwork, confident weapon control, and years of practiced technique.

However, she has not yet experienced real warfare.

Her skill comes from years of training rather than battlefield experience.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

Riven does not speak in this scene.


RIVEN'S FATHER:

Riven's Father must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video.

Preserve his facial appearance, hair, beard, body proportions, clothing, and overall silhouette.

He is the same quiet former warrior who raised Riven and taught her swordsmanship.

Many years have passed since he first taught her basic stance and grip.

He no longer needs to physically correct her movements.

He mainly watches her train.

Their relationship should feel familiar, quiet, and natural.

He does not speak in this scene.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

The scene takes place beside Riven's family cottage in the same peaceful medieval-fantasy mountain village where she grew up.

Maintain the recognizable environment:

the small family cottage,
the old tree,
the chopping area,
stacked firewood,
the dirt-and-grass training area,
the village road,
nearby cottages,
the broad green valley,
and rugged mountains in the distance.

The village is peaceful and safe.

Soft natural daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Subtle chimney smoke.

Quiet rural activity.

The dirt road passing through the village is clearly visible from the training area.

Nothing is damaged.

Nothing is burning.

There is no danger.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight and metal physics.

Realistic footwork and body balance.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict character appearance, costume consistency, sword consistency, and body proportions throughout the entire video.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Patient pacing.

Restrained editing.

Avoid excessive cuts.

Avoid rapid montage.

Avoid exaggerated slow motion.

Avoid supernatural movement.

Avoid flashy magical effects.

Avoid acrobatics.

Avoid spinning attacks.

Avoid exaggerated sword choreography.

This is NOT a battle.

This is NOT a rapid training montage.

The entire scene takes place as one continuous moment.

Riven is already skilled.

Do not portray her as a beginner.

Do not make her fall.

Do not make her struggle to hold the sword.

Do not have her Father physically correct her stance or grip.

No dialogue.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No intelligible background conversations.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Audio:

gentle mountain wind,
distant birds,
quiet village ambience,
boots moving against dirt,
realistic sword movement through air,
Riven's controlled breathing,
subtle movement of clothing and equipment,
later, distant horse hooves and subtle military equipment sounds.

No dramatic background music.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open directly on Riven practicing swordsmanship in the dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

The audience receives no verbal explanation of how much time has passed.

The passage of many years is communicated visually through Riven herself.

The little girl who once struggled with a sword is now completely comfortable holding one.

Riven performs a short sequence of grounded, controlled sword movements.

Her stance is stable.

Her footwork is precise.

Her grip is confident.

Her attacks are efficient.

Her recovery after every movement is clean.

The sword still has believable physical weight, but Riven understands how to move naturally with its momentum.

She does not show off.

She does not perform unnecessary flourishes.

Her Father stands nearby quietly observing.

He does not correct her.

He does not need to.

Riven completes the sequence cleanly and remains balanced.

Then distant horse hooves become audible from the village road.

Riven hears them.

She stops training.

Her attention shifts toward the sound.

A small disciplined group of medieval-fantasy soldiers is traveling through the village.

They are not attacking.

They are not threatening anyone.

They are simply passing through.

Riven watches them with quiet fascination.

Her attention is drawn to their disciplined movement, practical armor, weapons, horses, and the confidence of people accustomed to traveling beyond this isolated valley.

For Riven, they represent something she has never truly experienced:

the wider world beyond her home.

Riven looks briefly at the sword in her own hand.

Then she looks back toward the soldiers.

Her Father notices this.

His attention shifts away from the traveling soldiers and toward his daughter.

He understands what has captured her attention.

Riven does not notice him watching.

Neither character speaks.

Riven does not approach the soldiers.

Riven does not follow them.

End quietly.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — YEARS LATER

Begin with an extreme close-up of Riven's sword moving through the air.

The blade passes cleanly through frame with controlled speed.

The sound of the blade cutting through the air is sharp but realistic.

Pull back naturally and reveal Riven training in the familiar dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

Riven is already in motion.

She performs a controlled diagonal cut.

Her feet remain firmly positioned.

She immediately recovers the sword.

She changes her footing naturally.

She performs another practical movement.

The choreography is simple, efficient, and believable.

Do not turn this into a flashy combat combination.

The important difference is control.

Years ago, the sword controlled Riven's movement.

Now Riven controls the sword.

Its physical weight is still visible through her shoulders, hips, footwork, and momentum.

Riven transitions smoothly into one final controlled strike.

She stops the blade deliberately.

Returns to a stable stance.

Remains completely balanced.

Her breathing is controlled.

Hold briefly.

Reveal her Father nearby.

He has been quietly watching.

He does not correct her.

He does not give instructions.

He simply observes.

There should be a clear visual contrast with Riven's childhood training:

she no longer needs his hands correcting her grip,
she no longer loses her balance,
she no longer struggles with the weapon.

She has grown into the skill she once wanted.

Then:

distant horse hooves.

Riven hears them.

Her eyes shift toward the sound.

Her training stops.

She lowers the sword slightly.

CUT.


Shot 2 — THE WORLD BEYOND HOME

Follow Riven's attention toward the village road.

A small group of medieval-fantasy soldiers is traveling through the peaceful village.

The group should feel grounded and believable.

Some soldiers walk.

Some may travel slowly on horseback.

Their armor is practical and weathered rather than ceremonial.

Their weapons are carried naturally.

Their equipment moves realistically as they travel.

Their formation is organized and disciplined.

These soldiers are simply traveling through the region.

They are NOT attacking the village.

They are NOT intimidating villagers.

They are NOT behaving aggressively.

Do not portray them as sinister.

Do not create ominous imagery.

Do not foreshadow their future role as villains.

At this point in Riven's life, soldiers represent purpose, discipline, and the larger world she has imagined since childhood.

Ordinary village life continues naturally around them.

Riven watches silently from beside her cottage.

Show the soldiers primarily through Riven's perspective.

Her attention moves across small details:

worn armor from travel,

real military weapons,

horses carrying equipment,

disciplined posture,

coordinated movement,

people clearly accustomed to traveling far beyond this valley.

Nothing spectacular happens.

The importance comes entirely from Riven's reaction.

CUT.


Shot 3 — BEYOND THE VILLAGE

Return to Riven.

She stands completely still in the training area.

Her sword is lowered naturally beside her.

Her training has been forgotten for the moment.

The soldiers continue farther along the village road in the background.

Riven follows them with her eyes.

Her expression remains restrained.

Do not make her smile broadly.

Do not make her visibly excited.

Do not create a heroic pose.

Instead, show quiet fascination and curiosity.

Riven watches one of the traveling soldiers carrying a sword naturally while moving with the group.

Her eyes remain on the weapon for a moment.

Then Riven slowly looks down.

She looks at the sword in her own hand.

Hold.

Nothing magical happens.

The sword does not glow.

There is no vision.

There is no flashback.

There is no supernatural effect.

It is simply Riven looking at the weapon she has spent years learning to use.

Then she raises her eyes again.

She looks beyond the village.

The soldiers are moving farther down the road toward the valley beyond her home.

For the first time, the wider world feels tangible rather than imaginary.

Gentle wind moves Riven's pale-blonde hair and clothing.

Hold on her thoughtful expression.

Then shift attention naturally toward her Father.

He initially looks toward the road.

Then he looks at Riven.

He sees where her attention is.

He sees the sword in her hand.

He sees her watching the soldiers disappear beyond the village.

His expression changes only slightly.

He understands.

Do not make him visibly sad.

Do not make him smile.

Do not make the moment sentimental.

He simply realizes that his daughter is beginning to look beyond the life she has always known.

Riven does not notice her Father's gaze.

Neither character speaks.

The soldiers continue farther away.

Riven remains where she is.

She does not follow them.

Hold the final quiet composition:

Riven in the familiar place where she grew up,

her sword in her hand,

her Father nearby,

and the road stretching beyond the village toward the wider world.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven remains beside her family cottage.

She holds her sword naturally at her side.

Her Father stands nearby.

The traveling soldiers are disappearing along the road beyond the village.

Riven silently watches them leave.

She has not joined them.

She has not followed them.

She has not announced any decision.

Her Father has noticed the way she watches them.

He understands that something has changed.

Riven is still physically standing at home,

but mentally, for the first time, she is looking beyond it.

Neither character speaks.

End in silence.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Grounded.

Reflective.

Quietly ambitious.

Restrained.

The scene should communicate the passage of many years without explaining it.

The visual contrast with Riven's childhood is enough:

as a child, she struggled to control a sword;

now, she handles one naturally.

The emotional progression is simple:

Riven trains confidently
→ she completes the sequence cleanly
→ horse hooves interrupt the quiet
→ soldiers pass through the village
→ Riven becomes fascinated
→ she studies their weapons and discipline
→ she looks at her own sword
→ she looks toward the road beyond home
→ her Father notices.

Do not add another story event.

Do not have Riven speak.

Do not have her Father speak.

Do not have Riven approach the soldiers.

Do not have the soldiers approach Riven.

Do not have the soldiers recruit her.

Do not have Riven leave home.

Do not turn the soldiers into villains.

Do not introduce conflict.

The scene ends only with the first clear suggestion that Riven wants to discover the world beyond her village.
